title: Tangent cone and minimal-prime dimensions of an essentially smooth local extension
statement:
Let $(A,\mathfrak m,K)$ and $(B,\mathfrak n,L)$ be nonzero local commutative $\mathbf Q$-algebras essentially of finite type (localizations of finitely generated $\mathbf Q$-algebras) [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra]. Let $A\to B$ be a local homomorphism which is essentially smooth [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map], meaning a localization of a smooth algebra. Set $F=B/\mathfrak mB$ and $s=\dim F$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Then $F$ is regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme], and there is an isomorphism of graded $L$-algebras
$$\operatorname{gr}_{\mathfrak n}B\simeq (L\otimes_K\operatorname{gr}_{\mathfrak m}A)[T_1,\ldots,T_s],$$
where associated graded rings are $\bigoplus_{j\ge0}\mathfrak m^j/\mathfrak m^{j+1}$ and similarly for $B$ [def-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring], $T_i$ have degree one, and the isomorphism restricts to the induced map on the base graded algebra. Moreover the sets of dimensions of minimal-prime quotients satisfy
$$\{\dim(B/\mathfrak q):\mathfrak q\text{ a minimal prime of }B\}=\{\dim(A/\mathfrak p)+s:\mathfrak p\text{ a minimal prime of }A\}.$$
No bijection of minimal primes, and no equality of residue fields, is asserted.
